summary: The mayor reports the budget in a steady, unshowy voice and turns the total into what it costs an ordinary household.
realLife: Three mayors reporting a year's budget kept to short sentences, thanked staff, and set the bill for a typical home next to the reason for it. One was upbeat about reserves, one rueful about repairs put off for years, and one called his plan lean and no-frills.
sources: Mayor Hopkins, Cranston RI, FY26 budget address to the City Council, Apr 1, 2025: https://www.cranstonri.gov/mayor-hopkins-delivers-fy26-budget-address-before-city-council/
John Hamilton, Bloomington IN mayor, opening of the 2020 budget presentation to the City Council, Aug 2019: https://www.bloomington.in.gov/mayor/speeches/2019/08/20/4185
Ben Florsheim, Middletown CT mayor, message to residents on the proposed budget, Apr 1, 2025: https://middletownct.gov/Archive.aspx?ADID=3691
Read by the local and campaign speeches writer's helper, Nov 24, 2026; some pages were read in part or through a page summary, and every description is a paraphrase.
inGame: personality-v1 facets practical and calm on the mayor's person record, with the budget condition (a tax change on the year's books) deciding how much of the household bill is spoken

turns.way: The mayor leaves the household bill out and reports only the total.
turns.pulledBy: a mayor with a blunt, impatient facet and a small change in the tax bill
turns.writes: a one-line total with no example home
